interview.name: Jules
interview.answer: I don’t have enough information to determine the current time or location of the repair drive.

reflections: Faye is a practical coordinator who helps align logistics and timing around the repair drive.
Jules is proactive and collaborative, taking initiative to spread the word and follow the suggested contact chain.
Mara seems well connected to local organizers and is responsive in supplying materials and guidance.
Jules is a central coordinator who keeps multiple people aligned on timing, contacts, and follow-up.
Mara appears to hold key logistics details and is expected to share materials that others can help distribute.
Several people are supportive and responsive, with coordination happening through a small network around the repair drive.
Jules is coordinating a small community effort and reliably loops people in as information comes in.
Nell, Ira, Bo, and Hana are responsive and willing to help, but they prefer confirmed details before taking broader action.
The group seems organized around shared neighborhood contacts like Mara and the Maple/Pine block captains to spread updates quickly.
Jules tends to be a cautious coordinator: they repeatedly avoid guessing and wait for confirmation before spreading updates.
Several people are relying on the same status check, so clear and timely confirmation is important to keep plans aligned.
The community effort seems organized around a few local contacts, especially Mara and the block captains, with people checking in through them for logistics.
Jules is careful not to confirm details before they are verified, and others rely on him for timely status updates.
Kira and Sam are both waiting on the repair drive status, but Sam is comfortable letting Jules check with the block captains first.
Hana and Jules are coordinating on the repair drive information, with Hana handling confirmation and Jules helping distribute the update once it is ready.

events.text: Faye: I can help coordinate around the school schedule for the repair drive—what time window are you thinking?
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Faye — that’d help a lot. I’m thinking a late afternoon window, maybe 3:30 to 5:30, so folks can swing by after pickup.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Faye: That should work well — I’ll check the school pickup timing and see if we can keep the drive open in that 3:30 to 5:30 window.
events.speaker: Faye

events.text: Jules: I’m happy to help spread the word about the repair drive—who should I check in with first?
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Mara: Start with the block captains on Maple and Pine—they’ve been helping us coordinate. I’ll send you the flyer details right after this.
events.speaker: Mara

events.text: Jules: Great, I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep an eye out for your flyer details.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Nell: I’m still catching up on the details—what’s the latest on the repair drive?
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Jules: The latest is we’re aiming for a 3:30 to 5:30 window so folks can stop by after pickup, and I’m checking in with the Maple and Pine block captains first. I’m also still waiting on Mara’s flyer details to help spread the word.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Nell: That makes sense—thanks for the update. If you get Mara’s flyer details, I’d be happy to help spread the word too.
events.speaker: Nell

events.text: Jules: Sounds good — I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep an eye out for your flyer details.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Ira: Thanks, Jules — that’d be great. I’m out running errands now, so I’ll keep an eye out too and let you know if I hear anything.
events.speaker: Ira

events.text: Jules: Perfect, thanks Ira — I’ll touch base with the captains and loop you in as soon as I hear back.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Bo: Sounds good — who’s first on the list, and what needs fixing?
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Jules: I’d start with Mara and the Maple/Pine block captains so the word gets out quickly. We can also ask folks to note what needs fixing when they stop by.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Bo: That works — I’ll start with Mara and the block captains, then ask people to jot down what needs fixing when they stop by.
events.speaker: Bo

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the details, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’ll confirm whether the repair drive has started and how the donations are going.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — just let me know when you’ve confirmed, and I’ll help spread the word once we have the details.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: I’m checking now, and I’ll confirm the repair drive status and donation progress as soon as I have the details.
events.speaker: Hana

events.text: Opal: Sunday at the community center is still on my list—should I meet you there, or has the starting point changed?
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Jules: Sunday at the community center still sounds like the right start to me—want me to check in with Mara or the Maple/Pine captains to confirm?
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Opal: Yes, please check with Mara or the Maple/Pine captains and confirm the start is still Sunday at the community center. I’ll keep that as my meeting point unless you hear otherwise.
events.speaker: Opal

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Sunday at the community center.

events.text: Jules: I’m still checking the details, so I don’t want to guess yet. I’ll let you know as soon as I can confirm the repair drive status and donation progress.

events.text: Kira: Can you confirm when you’ll have the details? I just want to make sure we know the repair drive status before Saturday.
events.speaker: Kira

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Jules: I should have a confirmed update soon, and I’ll share it with you as soon as I know the repair drive status before Saturday.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Jules: I’m still waiting on the confirmed repair drive update, but I should have it soon and I’ll share it with you before Saturday. If you want, I can also check in with the main block captains first.
events.speaker: Jules

prov.value: The repair drive is being held on Saturday at the front porch.

events.text: Sam: Thanks, Jules — I’d appreciate that. I’m happy to wait for the update, and checking with the block captains first sounds like a good idea.
events.speaker: Sam

events.text: Jules: I’ll check in with the Maple and Pine block captains first and keep you posted as soon as I have the confirmed repair drive update.
events.speaker: Jules

events.text: Hana: I’m still checking the repair drive details, so I don’t want to guess yet. Once I confirm what’s left, I’ll share the status and donation progress.

events.text: Jules: Thanks, Hana — just let me know once you’ve confirmed the repair drive status and donation progress, and I’ll help spread the word.

events.text: Hana: Thanks, Jules — I’m checking the details now, and I’ll let you know the repair drive status and donation progress as soon as I confirm it.
